tasks.title: Prime-Factor Semiprime Shell Residual Validation: Repair of the Original Experiment
tasks.frontier: The historical return is preserved, but its broad RESIDUE_OR_DENSITY_ARTIFACT hard-target closure is not accepted while occupancy-conditioned null support, misidentified prime-rank coordinates, and missing residual profiles remain unresolved.
tasks.next_action: Freeze a correction manifest with the actual source-exposure state; retain every geometrically eligible p position including zero q-prime counts, or explicitly state and justify a different conditional target; implement genuine (pi(p), pi(q)) coordinates; persist all required per-cell raw, corrected, and signed cross-scale profiles; derive scientific gate labels from data. tasks.mother_question: The original mother question and hard target remain unchanged: does semiprime factor-shell occupancy retain reproducible cross-scale residual structure beyond small-prime, shell, residue-class and first-order density effects? This is a revision of the same task, not a new second-order research direction.

tasks.hard_target_and_required_outputs: Retain SEMIPRIME_FACTOR_SHELL_CROSS_SCALE_RESIDUAL_STRUCTURE_VALIDATED_OR_REFUTED and all eight original output obligations. Deliver: (1) exact generator plus independent spot checks; (2) an immutable correction manifest identifying preserved historical preregistration and the actual exposure state; (3) raw/corrected occupancy summaries for every original scale/width and every required view; (4) both original independent null families, with null support audited against geometric/domain support and no undeclared conditioning on the occupied observed bins; (5) the fixed-coordinate cross-scale residual profiles and signed phase/correlation statistics; (6) the preregistered family-wise empirical threshold or explicit failure to reconstruct it; (7) an honest holdout evaluation with no fabricated blindness; and (8) a replacement return separating reproduced narrow observations from unsupported broad closure. Address the prime_rank naming/implementation mismatch explicitly, and include a discrepancy ledger for the three reported defects. Never overwrite the old result or its NONE_WITHIN_TASK_HARD_TARGET string to erase the historical claim. Also remove hard-coded scientific PASS/terminal labels, state the valid primality-check domain, and handle the p<=sqrt(U) versus u<=1/2 square-boundary mismatch explicitly. These are implementation/scope corrections within the original experiment; they are not an all-scale theorem or a new blind run.
tasks.research_value_to_preserve: Keep the native progressive-plane interpretation and the original primary statistical question. An S3 orbit remains a derived diagnostic, not a change of native ontology. Preserve exact original counts and useful negative boundaries without promoting missing or contaminated evidence to a clean negative theorem. No secondary coloring, holonomy, carry, or Prime Fusion route may rescue a failed primary gate.
tasks.success_kill_and_return_criteria: Success is a complete, replayable correction assessment of the original hard target with every required output accounted for and all three defects resolved or sharply bounded. A narrower negative conclusion is allowed only at the strength actually supported. If support selection, genuine prime-rank evidence, cross-scale profiles, or honest holdout provenance cannot be supplied, return BLOCKED/partial with the exact residue and preserve the unclosed hard target. Do not accept NONE as unresolved residue, claim a global theorem, or open a second-order successor without a separate actual Driver decision and successor contract. The new publication confers no claim or execution rights; use the canonical winning-claim/runtime guard for the new generation.
